events.title: Steam Next Fest: The Updated Loopstructor 2: Skyspine Demo Is Here!
events.summary: Hello, conductors! We’re joining Steam Next Fest with an updated demo of Loopstructor 2: Skyspine!The sequel to Loopstructor brings a fresh approach to tower defense, built around track planning. Nuclear devastation has left the surface in ruins, but the world below is no safe haven. Your defenses are war trains loaded with turrets, circling the battlefield to meet the swarms.New to the game? Download the demo and give it a try for free. Played an earlier version? Come back and see what’s change

events.title: is Coming to BitSummit PUNCH!
events.summary: Hello everyone!From May 23 to 24, Loopstructor 2: Skyspine will be joining Indie Games Pass in Kyoto, Japan for BitSummit PUNCH!Visitors will be able to try the latest version of the game at the event, and we’ll also have various merch and goodies to give away.Members of the development team will be there as well, so if you’re planning to attend, feel free to stop by booth 3F-A14 and say hi!We look forward to seeing you there!

events.title: Shape the Rails! Playtest Rail Defence: Eldritch Siege Out Now!

events.title: The Rails Await: “Rail Defence: Eldritch Siege” Playtest Incoming.
